sv.title: S: De ville inte vara med V: Bad om att få vara med
sv.summary: Mikael Damberg (S): Vänsterpartiet säger att de inte deltar i förhandlingar om sakpolitiken. Ida Gabrielsson (V): Vi bad om att få vara med och diskutera. Det stormar mellan de rödgröna partierna.

en.title: S: They didn't want to be included V: Asked to be included
en.summary: Mikael Damberg (S): The Left Party says they are not taking part in negotiations on policy issues. Ida Gabrielsson (V): We asked to be included and to discuss. There is a storm between the red-green parties.
